title: Bluegrass
style: Starts with lively banjo picking and fiddle lines weaving melodic motifs, joined by upright bass and brisk acoustic guitar. Mandolin and harmonica add sparkle throughout. Festive group harmonies and bursts of handclaps drive soaring choruses, building a spirited bluegrass Christmas atmosphere.
lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Snow’s fallin’ down on the old front porch
Fire’s cracklin’ warm and bright
Mama’s hummin’ “Silent Night,”
While Daddy tunes that mandolin tight.
Grandpa’s tappin’ his worn-out boots
As the fiddle starts to chime
Ain’t nothin’ like that mountain joy —
It’s Bluegrass Christmas time!

(Chorus)
Pick that banjo, let it ring
Hear the sleigh bells join and sing
From the holler to the pine
It’s a Bluegrass Christmas time!
Hot cocoa, love, and a little moonshine
Everybody feelin’ fine
Raise your voice and clap in time —
It’s a Bluegrass Christmas time!

(Verse 2)
Cousins laughin’ ‘round the tree
Strings and bows in harmony
Cookies bakin’, snowflakes shakin’
Hearts as light as they can be.
We ain’t got no silver sleigh
But we got rhythm, rhyme, and twine
And Jesus’ love to light our way —
It’s Bluegrass Christmas time!

(Chorus)
Pick that banjo, let it ring
Hear the sleigh bells join and sing
From the holler to the pine
It’s a Bluegrass Christmas time!
Hot cocoa, love, and a little moonshine
Everybody feelin’ fine
Raise your voice and clap in time —
It’s a Bluegrass Christmas time!

(Bridge)
Grab that fiddle, play it sweet
Let that bass tap out the beat
Neighbors comin’ down the road
Carolin’ in their Sunday clothes.

(Final Chorus)
Pick that banjo, let it ring
Hear the sleigh bells join and sing
From the holler to the pine
It’s a Bluegrass Christmas time!
Hearts are merry, spirits high
Stars are dancin’ in the sky
Lord above, it’s pure divine —
It’s a Bluegrass Christmas time!

(Tag)
Yeehaw! Snow and strings entwine —
It’s a Bluegrass Christmas time!
